svg.aria-label: The format-convert mode of the paper skill. Boxes: The session's questions, in one message (stop); The target to settle (stop); Formatter: LaTeX, DOCX, PDF, Markdown, citation style, as patches (agent); Formatter, resumed: the conversion patch, when the citation style changes (agent, only when needed); Script: patches applied, compile, pandoc, the counts (script); A converted file to replace (stop); Formatted document (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
